messages:
Nina Park: Uploaded the near-final launch post copy + assets. Please do a last-pass: hero wording, CTA destinations, benchmark callout, and webinar link. Target publish: Fri 09:00am PT.
Ethan Moore: Quick read  looks tight. Two notes: move benchmark callout up under hero; shorten the first paragraph by one sentence.
Carlos Vega: Ops ask: confirm HubSpot form ID and webhook URL so I can wire redirects. Prefer form=HS-4521 and webhook=/webhooks/marketing/hs-reg.
Hannah Reed: Legal quick-pass: change "cheapest" to "more cost-effective" and add parentheses with the benchmark percent if you're going to keep a claim.
Samir Das: CTA variants ready: A=See cost breakdown (HS-4521 list), B=Book a demo (HS-Demo). We'll randomize 60/40 to favor cost breakdown. Add hidden field "variant".
Jules Harper: I'll drop the anonymized customer quote under the stats. Also uploaded the cropped hero for mobile.
Nina Park: Thanks  I'll make those edits now. @Carlos please confirm when webhooks and form live; @Samir send the experiment id so analytics can hook up.
Carlos Vega: Form HS-4521 live. Webhook deployed to /webhooks/marketing/hs-reg and secret stored in ops-vault -> path: vault://marketing/hs/webhook-secret. Test payload example posted in the doc.
Samir Das: Experiment id = exp_launch_2026_05_10. Added hidden field variant and experiment_id to the form.
Hannah Reed: Approved with the wording change. Good to go from legal.
Nina Park: Final plan: publish Fri 09:00am PT, run A/B, route demo intent to HS-Demo, nurturing workflow for others. Ops confirm smoke test by 8:15am PT.
Carlos Vega: Smoke test scheduled 08:20am PT. I'll post results.
Jules Harper: All assets finalized and in the doc. :sparkles:
Nina Park: Perfect. Thanks team ":tada:"
